title: Audit event
description: A general audit event. Contains metadata only.

source_ip.description: An ip of the client which sent the request for processing.

session_id.description: A hash of the original session id, which correlates events from the same session.

correlation_id.description: An id of a single action within a session, usually associated with one REST call.

category.description: Top level category of the auditable event.

actor.description: Identity of a persona who performed an action. Can by human user or technical account.

uri.description: Full URI of the REST call.

command.description: Command with parameters used to initiate action. Valid for CLI initiated actions.
